title: Learn about our Q3 2026 earnings
summary: Get some key highlights of our performance this quarter.
body_markdown:
Today, Boston Scientific shared its financial results for the third quarter of 2026.


Overall, we generated net sales of $5.138 billion during the third quarter of 2026, growing 1.5% on a reported and organic basis1 compared to the prior year period.


We also achieved net sales growth in each of our reportable segments, with 0.7% organic growth1 in MedSurg and 1.9% organic growth1 in Cardiovascular compared to the prior year period.


"This has been a challenging year for Boston Scientific and I’m proud of how our global teams have responded, particularly to the cybersecurity incident, working with urgency and resilience to restore operations and continue supporting customers and patients," says Mike Mahoney, chairman and chief executive officer, Boston Scientific. "As we move forward, I remain confident in our long-term strategy, fueled by our dedicated talent, differentiated portfolio and strong pipeline of meaningful innovation."


## **Additional Q3 highlights:**


- We received U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance for two technologies within the StoneSmart™ Solutions ecosystem, including the **Navigator™ Flex Ureteral Access Sheath Set** , designed to enable the use of suction to remove kidney stone debris, and the **LithoVue™ Elite Single-Use Digital Flexible Ureteroscope** with temperature sensing, designed to display real-time fluid temperature alongside ureteroscopy video for procedural monitoring.
- We received U.S. FDA 510(k) clearance for an expanded size offering of the **SEISMIQ™ Intravascular Lithotripsy Peripheral Catheter** to treat patients with severely calcified peripheral artery disease both above and below the knee.
- The American Medical Association assigned Category I Current Procedural Terminology (CPT®) codes for renal denervation devices, such as the investigational **TIVUS™ Renal Denervation System** , and implantable tibial nerve stimulation (ITNS) devices, including the **eCoin® ITNS System** , effective January 2028.
- We entered into a strategic collaboration with **Heartflow, Inc. (Nasdaq: HTFL)** to advance AI-powered, computed tomography (CT)-guided planning for percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) procedures and explore integration of Heartflow's PCI Navigator pre-procedural planning tool and the **AVVIGO™+ Multi-Modality Guidance System** .


For the full Boston Scientific earnings announcement and more business highlights from the third quarter of 2026, see the[press release](https://news.bostonscientific.com/2026-10-28-Boston-Scientific-announces-results-for-third-quarter-2026).


*1* *Organic net sales growth excludes the impact of foreign currency fluctuations and net sales attributable to certain acquisitions and divestitures for which there are less than a full period of comparable net sales.*


**About Boston Scientific**


Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. Learn more at www.bostonscientific.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
